fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU -13.89%) lost nearly half its market cap over five months, but Wall Street consensus target price reflects 160% upside from current levels.
fields.summary_ko.1: In a bull scenario, share price reaches $1,800–$2,200 by end of 2029 (3.2x at midpoint), and in a bear scenario $400–$600, with Chinese competitor CXMT's HBM technology advances and AI infrastructure investment slowdown as risk factors.
